title: Glass Shelf With Integrated Towel Bar, Triple Tier 16-Inch, Solid Brass & Tempered Glass, Wall Mount - Glass Shelves Collection, Allied Brass
body_html:

  • Organize toiletries and decor with three tiers of tempered, beveled-edge glass.

  • Finish options: Multiple designer finish options available
